The <b>diving bell</b> is a crucial part of the <i>[[SEEK: The Dark Below]]</i> and <i>[[DESCEND: Last Dive]]</i> [[Objectives|objectives]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can only be accessed in [[Act 3]].

<h2>Use</h2>
The diving bell is the only way to access [[the Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] below the magma layer of [[Deep Docks]]. After using it for the first time during <i>SEEK: The Dark Below</i>, the diving bell's shield breaks and it cannot be used to ascend back up to Deep Docks. 

When the [[Everbloom]] has been obtained, the diving bell is repaired and improved by [[Ballow]] and is used to descend to the Abyss once more for the <i>DESCEND: Last Dive</i> objective. After this, the Diving Bell can be used to move to and from the Abyss at any time.

<h2>Location</h2>
The diving bell is located in an area in Deep Docks that can only be accessed after defeating the [[Bosses (Silksong)|bosses]] [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]]. However, it cannot be opened until Act 3.<ref>Ballow: <i>Hmmm... Well if you head down below to the very base of the docks, there's an old diving bell built for just what you're askin'. Thing is, you can ride it, but it takes an operator stood dockside to send it. I might be capable, but I ain't got time for naught else while the shovelling still needs doing.</i></ref> Inspecting the diving bell's door shows the text: <i>"An old diving bell. Its door is shut tight by an ornate clamp."</i>

{{Gallery
|Image1=Mapshot SS SignisGron.png!Forebrothers Signis & Gron location
}}

Upon completing the <i>[[SEEK: Awaiting the End]]</i> objective, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is directed to seek out aid in Deep Docks. After speaking to [[Ballow]] there, he moves to the control room above the diving bell<ref>Ballow: <i>Grfff... So it's gotten that bad, aye? I guess... If that's how it is, I'll be your bug. Meet me below, at the diving bell. We'll see if I can get you ready for the drop.</i></ref> and gives the [[Diving Bell Key]] to Hornet. This can be used to open the door to the diving bell.<ref>Ballow: <i>I'll work it best's I can. Can't do much more, I'm afraid. At least the forgings of these docks were built to last. Now we's only gotta pray they hold for you. Here's the key that'll see you inside its metal belly. Pop in there once you're feelin' good and ready. In the meantime, I'll get to seeing things set up here.</i></ref>
